title: List of production errors
summary:
General Errors=
10. The Treasures of the Argonauts
• The port city of Velo, Greece, is incorrectly called Velos.

19. Ladies' Choice
• When Lok Lambert falls off the statue of Diana, in the following shot, the statue is missing. It then returns in the next shot.

24. The Secret of Two Generations
• When Zhalia scans the third card to get into a room in the Organization Central, the picture on the card is of Mr. Koskin, despite both the automated voice and Zhalia stating that it belongs to Klaus.
• When Dante invokes Ignatius, the Amulet and icon of Caliban are shown instead of those of Ignatius.

30. Knight of the Willblade
• When LeBlanche uses Newlife to restore King Basilisk, Wilder is seen outside, standing next to Stack. However, at this point in the episode he is already inside the castle, fighting with Lok and Sophie. In the next shot, he has changed back to Unnamed Suit 054.

31. Chasing Void
• Sabriel returns to what appears to be a Powerbonded-looking version of Sabriel's Amulet instead of Sophie's hand.

41. Gremlow Infestation!
• Gremlow is misidentified as a Yama-Titan by the Holotome, contradicting with Gremlow's multiple Litho-Titan traits: his stone-like armor and physiology, purple energy essence, Litho-Titan amulet coloration, and geographical and mythological ties to Europe. Moreover, Gremlow is listed as a Litho-Titan on the show's official artist reference sheets, therefore the line is confirmed to be a scripting error.
• When Sophie summons Powerbonded Sabriel, her non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.
• The city of Hamelin, Germany, was misspelled as "Hamlin".

43. Lok's Leadership
• When Lok summons Powerbonded Lindorm, his non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.
• When Sophie summons Powerbonded Sorcerel, her non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.

44. The Dead Magic Island
• When Sophie summons Powerbonded Sabriel, her non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.
• Shadow Kuolit is invoked by a male Casterwill Hunter; however, when the same Titan is defeated, it returns to the amulet of a different, female Casterwill Hunter.

46. An Ally from the Organization
• Megataur is sent back to its Amulet twice by Undergolem, without being re-invoked in between: once when punched and again when thrown into a wall.

49. Words from Eathon
• "Venice" is spelled incorrectly as "Veneice" on screen at the start of the episode.

52. Dante's Return
• When Zhalia invokes Powerbonded Gareon, his non-Powerbonded icon is incorrectly shown.

English=

52. Dante's Return
• When Lucas and Sandra arrive to help the team, Cherit's mouth moves as if he's talking but nothing is heard. In the Portuguese dub, he says "Oh, it's Lucas and Sandra!" [trans.]

Italian=

21. Coming of Age
• When Rassimov fires Hopeshatter at Baselaird, he incorrectly says "Darkvoid" instead.

52. Dante's Return
• When Lucas and Sandra arrive to help the team, Cherit's mouth moves as if he's talking but nothing is heard. In the Portuguese dub, he says "Oh, it's Lucas and Sandra!" [trans.]

French=
01. A Seeker Is Born
• "Seekers" are called "Guardians" by all the characters throughout the episode. This is corrected as soon as Episode 2.

02. The Casterwill Client
• When Unnamed Suit 002 casts "Augerfrost", he incorrectly says "Hyperstride" instead.

04. Into the River of Secrets
• "Eathon" is mistakenly pronounced as "Ethan" in the introduction.

11. The Beautiful Trap / 16. "The Bookshop Hunter"
• When Zhalia summons King Basilisk, she incorrectly says "Basilisk" instead of "Basilic", the French version of the word. This is corrected for all subsequent appearances.

35. Zhalia's Mission
• All of Wilder's lines from 9:18 to 9:41 are silent, most likely due to an editing error or to the voice actor not being available.

37. The Casterwill Connection
• When Lok casts Raypulse at Kiel with Sophie, he incorrectly says "Dragonfist" instead.

40. The Spiral War
• When Lok attacks two Silent Soldiers from the sky with Bladecall, he incorrectly says "Featherdrop" instead. This is particularly noticeable as he actually uses Featherdrop right after that.

43. Lok's Leadership
• Den's voice actor, Karim Barras, was mysteriously replaced by a non-identified actor for one single line ("You could be our leader anytime").

46. Rassimov's Secret
• When Harrison casts "Fireswarm" against Den Fears, it is not voiced.

52. Dante's Return
• When Lucas and Sandra arrive to help the team, Cherit's mouth moves as if he's talking but nothing is heard. In the Portuguese dub, he says "Oh, it's Lucas and Sandra!" [trans.]
